text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Placed on the board, huh... As expected of racers, every single Umamusume ran a breathtaking race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel I've learned a great deal.
...Though it is difficult to put into words.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I have to work much, much harder
so that I can make the most of this in our next race."
choice_data_list: You can count on my full support!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think I was rushing, but...
You're right, there's no need to disrupt my current pace.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The folks back home often told me that too.
"Don't push yourself too hard," and "Just run happily, that's enough."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I've decided. For the next race,
I'll eat even more than I did today before taking on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I want to become even faster
and compete against many more Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That'll definitely be more fun, and the audience
will get way more fired up too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "I will spare no effort for that goal. Please don't hold back in guiding me going forward."
